		while(_g < amount) {
			++_g;
			let node = this.create();
			node.next = this.head;
			this.head = node;
			this.size++;
		}
	}
	getSize() {
		return this.size;
	}
	clear() {
		this.head = null;
		this.size = 0;
	}
	create() {
		throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Using abstract pool create()");
	}
}

		let node;

			node = new astar_types_PathNode();
		} else {
			let node1 = this.head;
			this.head = this.head.next;
			node1.next = null;
			this.size--;

			node1.transition = 0;
			node1.visited = false;
			node1.next = node1.left = node1.right = node1.parent = null;
			node = node1;
		}
		node.state = state;
		node.transition = transition;
		node.costFromStart = costFromStart;
		node.estimatedCostToGoal = costToGoal;
		node.previous = previous;
		return node;
	}

	}

class astar_types_SortedPathNodeList {
	constructor() {
		this.root = null;
		this.min = null;
		this.size = 0;
	}
	isEmpty() {
		return this.size == 0;
	}
	clear(pool) {
		if(pool != null) {
			this.clearIntoPoolRecursive(this.root,pool);
		}
		this.root = null;
		this.min = null;
		this.size = 0;
	}
	insert(node) {
		this.size++;
		node.left = node.right = node.parent = null;
		if(this.root == null) {
			this.root = node;
			this.min = node;
			return;
		}
		let iter = this.root;
		while(iter != node) if(node.costFromStart + node.estimatedCostToGoal > iter.costFromStart + iter.estimatedCostToGoal) {
			if(iter.right == null) {
				node.parent = iter;
				iter.right = node;
				node.left = node.right = null;
			}
			iter = iter.right;
		} else {
			if(iter.left == null) {
				node.parent = iter;
				iter.left = node;
				node.left = node.right = null;
				if(iter == this.min) {
					this.min = node;
				}
			}
			iter = iter.left;
		}
	}
	popNext() {
		if(this.min == null) {
			return null;
		}
		this.size--;
		let node = this.min;
		if(node == this.root) {
			this.root = node.right;
			if(this.root != null) {
				this.root.parent = null;
			}
			let iter = node.right;
			while(iter != null && iter.left != null) iter = iter.left;
			this.min = iter;
		} else if(node.right != null) {
			let parent = node.parent;
			let node1 = node.right;
			node1.parent = parent;
			parent.left = node1;
			let iter = node.right;
			while(iter != null && iter.left != null) iter = iter.left;
			this.min = iter;
		} else {
			this.min = this.min.parent;
			this.min.left = null;
		}
		node.left = node.right = node.parent = null;
		return node;
	}
	remove(node) {
		if(this.root == null) {
			throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Cannot delete from an empty tree.");
		}
		if(node.parent == null && node.left == null && node.right == null) {
			if(node == this.root) {
				this.root = null;
				this.min = null;
				this.size = 0;
				return;
			} else {
				throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Attempting to remove node not present in the tree?");
			}
		}
		if(node.left == null && node.right == null) {
			if(node == this.min) {
				this.min = node.parent;
			}
			if(node.parent != null) {
				if(node.parent.left == node) {
					node.parent.left = null;
				} else if(node.parent.right == node) {
					node.parent.right = null;
				}
				node.parent = null;
			} else {
				this.root = null;
			}
		} else if(node.left == null) {
			if(node == this.min) {
				let node1 = node;
				node1 = node.right;
				while(node1.left != null) node1 = node1.left;
				this.min = node1;
			}
			let src = node.right;
			if(src.parent != null) {
				if(src.parent.left == src) {
					src.parent.left = null;
				} else if(src.parent.right == src) {
					src.parent.right = null;
				}
				src.parent = null;
			} else {
				this.root = null;
			}
			src.parent = node.parent;
			if(node.parent == null) {
				this.root = src;
			} else if(node == node.parent.left) {
				src.parent.left = src;
			} else {
				src.parent.right = src;
			}
			node.parent = null;
		} else if(node.right == null) {
			let src = node.left;
			if(src.parent != null) {
				if(src.parent.left == src) {
					src.parent.left = null;
				} else if(src.parent.right == src) {
					src.parent.right = null;
				}
				src.parent = null;
			} else {
				this.root = null;
			}
			src.parent = node.parent;
			if(node.parent == null) {
				this.root = src;
			} else if(node == node.parent.left) {
				src.parent.left = src;
			} else {
				src.parent.right = src;
			}
			node.parent = null;
		} else if(node.right.left == null) {
			let successor = node.right;
			node.right = successor.right;
			if(successor.parent != null) {
				if(successor.parent.left == successor) {
					successor.parent.left = null;
				} else if(successor.parent.right == successor) {
					successor.parent.right = null;
				}
				successor.parent = null;
			} else {
				this.root = null;
			}
			successor.parent = node.parent;
			if(node.parent == null) {
				this.root = successor;
			} else if(node == node.parent.left) {
				successor.parent.left = successor;
			} else {
				successor.parent.right = successor;
			}
			node.parent = null;
			successor.left = node.left;
			successor.right = node.right;
			if(successor.left != null) {
				successor.left.parent = successor;
			}
			if(successor.right != null) {
				successor.right.parent = successor;
			}
			node.left = node.right = null;
			if(node == this.min) {
				this.min = successor;
			}
			if(node == this.root) {
				this.root = successor;
			}
		} else {
			let node1 = node;
			node1 = node.right;
			while(node1.left != null) node1 = node1.left;
			let successor = node1;
			let successorParent = successor.parent;
			successorParent.left = successor.right;
			if(successor.right != null) {
				successor.right.parent = successorParent;
			}
			if(successor.parent != null) {
				if(successor.parent.left == successor) {
					successor.parent.left = null;
				} else if(successor.parent.right == successor) {
					successor.parent.right = null;
				}
				successor.parent = null;
			} else {
				this.root = null;
			}
			successor.parent = node.parent;
			if(node.parent == null) {
				this.root = successor;
			} else if(node == node.parent.left) {
				successor.parent.left = successor;
			} else {
				successor.parent.right = successor;
			}
			node.parent = null;
			successor.left = node.left;
			successor.right = node.right;
			if(successor.left != null) {
				successor.left.parent = successor;
			}
			if(successor.right != null) {
				successor.right.parent = successor;
			}
			node.left = node.right = null;
			if(node == this.min) {
				this.min = successor;
			}
			if(node == this.root) {
				this.root = successor;
			}
		}
		node.left = node.right = node.parent = null;
		this.size--;
	}
	getSize() {
		return this.size;
	}
	reparentNode(src,dst) {
		if(src.parent != null) {
			if(src.parent.left == src) {
				src.parent.left = null;
			} else if(src.parent.right == src) {
				src.parent.right = null;
			}
			src.parent = null;
		} else {
			this.root = null;
		}
		src.parent = dst.parent;
		if(dst.parent == null) {
			this.root = src;
		} else if(dst == dst.parent.left) {
			src.parent.left = src;
		} else {
			src.parent.right = src;
		}
		dst.parent = null;
	}
	replaceNode(src,dst) {
		if(src.parent != null) {
			if(src.parent.left == src) {
				src.parent.left = null;
			} else if(src.parent.right == src) {
				src.parent.right = null;
			}
			src.parent = null;
		} else {
			this.root = null;
		}
		src.parent = dst.parent;
		if(dst.parent == null) {
			this.root = src;
		} else if(dst == dst.parent.left) {
			src.parent.left = src;
		} else {
			src.parent.right = src;
		}
		dst.parent = null;
		src.left = dst.left;
		src.right = dst.right;
		if(src.left != null) {
			src.left.parent = src;
		}
		if(src.right != null) {
			src.right.parent = src;
		}
		dst.left = dst.right = null;
		if(dst == this.min) {
			this.min = src;
		}
		if(dst == this.root) {
			this.root = src;
		}
	}
	clearIntoPoolRecursive(node,pool) {
		if(node.left != null) {
			this.clearIntoPoolRecursive(node.left,pool);
		}
		if(node.right != null) {
			this.clearIntoPoolRecursive(node.right,pool);
		}
		node.next = pool.head;
		pool.head = node;
		pool.size++;
	}
	findMin(startingNode) {
		let iter = startingNode;
		while(iter != null && iter.left != null) iter = iter.left;
		this.min = iter;
	}
	addLeft(parent,node) {
		node.parent = parent;
		parent.left = node;
	}
	addRight(parent,node) {
		node.parent = parent;
		parent.right = node;
	}
	getInOrderSuccessorOf(node) {
		node = node.right;
		while(node.left != null) node = node.left;
		return node;
	}
	removeFromParent(node) {
		if(node.parent != null) {
			if(node.parent.left == node) {
				node.parent.left = null;
			} else if(node.parent.right == node) {
				node.parent.right = null;
			}
			node.parent = null;
		} else {
			this.root = null;
		}
	}
}

class ai_data_Inventory {
	constructor() {
		this.fruitSum = 0;
		this.wood = 0;
		this.iron = 0;
		this.banana = 0;
		this.apple = 0;
		this.lemon = 0;
		this.plum = 0;
	}
	update(values) {
		this.plum = Std.parseInt(values[0]);
		this.lemon = Std.parseInt(values[1]);
		this.apple = Std.parseInt(values[2]);
		this.banana = Std.parseInt(values[3]);
		this.iron = Std.parseInt(values[4]);
		this.wood = Std.parseInt(values[5]);
		this.fruitSum = this.plum + this.lemon + this.apple + this.banana;
	}
	subtractTrainingCosts(trollCount,speed,carry,harvest,chop) {
		let plumCost = trollCount + speed * speed;
		let lemonCost = trollCount + carry * carry;
		let appleCost = trollCount + harvest * harvest;
		let ironCost = trollCount + chop * chop;
		this.plum -= plumCost;
		this.lemon -= lemonCost;
		this.apple -= appleCost;
		this.iron -= ironCost;
		console.error(("training costs: plums " + plumCost + " lemons " + lemonCost + " apples " + appleCost + " iron " + ironCost));
	}
	getFruitAmount(fruit) {
		switch(fruit) {
		case "APPLE":
			return this.apple;
		case "BANANA":
			return this.banana;
		case "LEMON":
			return this.lemon;
		case "PLUM":
			return this.plum;
		default:
			return this.plum + this.lemon + this.apple + this.banana;
		}
	}
	getAnyFruit() {
		if(this.plum > 0) {
			return "PLUM";
		}
		if(this.lemon > 0) {
			return "LEMON";
		}
		if(this.apple > 0) {
			return "APPLE";
		}
		if(this.banana > 0) {
			return "BANANA";
		}
		return "NONE";
	}
	getFruitAmounts() {
		return [{ fruit : "PLUM", amount : this.plum},{ fruit : "LEMON", amount : this.lemon},{ fruit : "APPLE", amount : this.apple}];
	}
	toString() {
		return "plum " + this.plum + " lemon " + this.lemon + " apple " + this.apple + " banana " + this.banana + " iron " + this.iron + " wood " + this.wood;
	}

	}

		case "APPLE":
			return "APPLE";
		case "BANANA":
			return "BANANA";
		case "LEMON":
			return "LEMON";
		case "NONE":
			return "NONE";
		case "PLUM":
			return "PLUM";
		default:
			throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Error: Unknown tree type: " + sType);
		}
	}
	update(size,health,fruits,cooldown,isNearWater,isNearPlayer) {
		this.previousHealth = this.health;
		this.size = size;
		this.health = health;
		this.fruits = fruits;
		this.cooldown = cooldown;
		this.isNearWater = isNearWater;
		this.isNearPlayer = isNearPlayer;
		this.healthDecline = this.previousHealth - health;
	}
	getSizeAfter(frames) {
		if(frames == null) {
			frames = 0;
		}
		if(frames <= 0) {
			return this.size;
		}
		let cycles = this.getCycles(frames);
		let a = this.size + cycles;
		if(a < 4) {
			return a;
		} else {
			return 4;
		}
	}
	getHealthAfter(frames) {
		if(frames == null) {
			frames = 0;
		}
		if(frames <= 0) {
			return this.health;
		}
		let cycles = this.getCycles(frames);
		let a = this.size + cycles;
		return this.properties.healths[(a < 4 ? a : 4) - 1];
	}
	getFruitsAfter(frames) {
		if(frames == null) {
			frames = 0;
		}
		if(frames <= 0) {
			return this.fruits;
		}
		let cycles = this.getCycles(frames);
		let a = this.size + this.fruits + cycles - 4;
		let a1 = a < 3 ? a : 3;
		if(a1 > 0) {
			return a1;
		} else {
			return 0;
		}
	}
	getCooldownAfter(frames) {
		if(frames == null) {
			frames = 0;
		}
		let effectiveCooldown = this.isNearWater ? this.properties.cooldownNearWater : this.properties.cooldown;
		if(effectiveCooldown <= 0) {
			return 0;
		}
		let remaining = (this.cooldown - frames) % effectiveCooldown;
		if(remaining < 0) {
			remaining += effectiveCooldown;
		}
		if(remaining == 0) {
			return effectiveCooldown;
		} else {
			return remaining;
		}
	}
	getCycles(frames) {
		let effectiveCooldown = this.isNearWater ? this.properties.cooldownNearWater : this.properties.cooldown;
		if(effectiveCooldown <= 0) {
			return 0;
		}
		return (frames + (effectiveCooldown - this.cooldown)) / effectiveCooldown | 0;
	}

	addTask(task) {

	goAndAttack(priorities) {

		if(sortedOppTrees.length == 0) {
			return "";

			return this.evaluatePath(this.board.getPath(this.pos,targetTree.pos),"Tree");
		}
	}
	goChopping(player,priorities) {
		if(this.carrySum == this.carryCapacity) {
			return this.returnToShack();
		} else {
			let closestTree;
			switch(player) {
			case -1:case 0:
				closestTree = this.findClosestTree("ANY",player,0,this.carryCapacity);
				break;
			case 1:
				let sortedOppTrees = this.board.getSortedTreesAround(this.board.oppShack,this.pos);
				if(sortedOppTrees.length == 0) {
					return "";
				}
				closestTree = priorities.length == 0 ? sortedOppTrees[0] : this.getClosestTreeWithFruitPriorities(player,priorities,sortedOppTrees);
				break;
			}

				if(closestTree.pos == this.pos) {
					console.error(("troll " + this.id + " chop"));
					return "CHOP " + this.id;
				} else {
					return this.evaluatePath(this.board.getPath(this.pos,closestTree.pos),"Tree");
				}
			}
		}
		return "";
	}
	getClosestTreeWithFruitPriorities(player,priorities,sortedTreesAroundShack) {

		let _g = 0;
		while(_g < priorities.length) {
			let fruit = priorities[_g++];
			let _g1 = 0;
			while(_g1 < sortedTreesAroundShack.length) {
				let tree = sortedTreesAroundShack[_g1];
				++_g1;
				if(tree.type == fruit) {
					switch(player) {
					case 0:
						if(tree.isNearPlayer != 0) {
							continue;
						}
						break;
					case 1:
						if(tree.isNearPlayer != 1) {
							continue;
						}
						break;
					default:
					}
					closestTreeOfType = tree;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(closestTreeOfType != ai_data_Tree.NO_TREE) {
				break;
			}
		}
		if(closestTreeOfType != ai_data_Tree.NO_TREE) {
			return closestTreeOfType;
		} else {
			return sortedTreesAroundShack[0];
		}
	}
	goCoChopping(targetTree) {
		if(this.board.treePositionsMap.h.__keys__[targetTree.pos.__id__] == null) {
			this.isDoing = this.tasks.length > 0 ? this.tasks.shift() : ai_data_Task.Nothing;
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " continue with previous task " + Std.string(this.isDoing)));
			if(this.isDoing != ai_data_Task.Nothing) {
				return this.go();
			}
		}
		if(this.carrySum == this.carryCapacity) {
			if(this.isDoing != ai_data_Task.Nothing) {
				this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Harvest("ANY");
			}
			return this.returnToShack();
		} else if(targetTree.pos == this.pos) {
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " chop"));
			return "CHOP " + this.id;
		} else {
			return this.evaluatePath(this.board.getPath(this.pos,targetTree.pos),"CoChop");
		}
	}
	goHarvesting(resource) {
		if(this.carrySum == this.carryCapacity) {
			return this.returnToShack();
		} else {
			let closestTree = this.findClosestTree(resource,-1,1);
			if(closestTree != ai_data_Tree.NO_TREE) {
				if(closestTree.pos == this.pos) {
					console.error(("troll " + this.id + " harvest"));
					return "HARVEST " + this.id;
				} else {
					let pathToTree = this.board.getPath(this.pos,closestTree.pos);
					console.error(("troll " + this.id + " " + Std.string(this.isDoing) + " path to tree " + Std.string(closestTree.pos)));
					return this.evaluatePath(pathToTree,"Tree");
				}
			} else {
				console.error(("troll " + this.id + " no " + resource + " tree to harvest"));
				if(this.tasks.length > 0) {
					this.isDoing = this.tasks.shift();
					this.go();
				} else {
					let _g = this.isDoing;
					if(_g._hx_index == 4) {
						if(_g.fruit == "ANY") {
							return "";
						} else {
							this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Harvest("ANY");
							this.go();
						}
					} else {
						this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Harvest("ANY");
						this.go();
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return "";
	}
	goMining() {
		if(this.carrySum == this.carryCapacity) {
			return this.returnToShack();
		} else {
			let closestIron = this.findClosestIronNeighbor();
			if(closestIron != xa3_math_Pos.NO_POS) {
				if(closestIron == this.pos) {
					console.error(("troll " + this.id + " mine"));
					return "MINE " + this.id;
				} else {
					let pathToIron = this.board.getPath(this.pos,closestIron);
					console.error(("troll " + this.id + " to to mine " + Std.string(closestIron)));
					return this.evaluatePath(pathToIron,"Iron");
				}
			}
		}
		return "";
	}
	goPlanting(fruit) {
		let carryFruit;
		switch(fruit) {
		case "APPLE":
			carryFruit = this.carryApple;
			break;
		case "BANANA":
			carryFruit = this.carryBanana;
			break;
		case "IRON":
			throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Error: troll " + this.id + " cannot plant iron");
		case "LEMON":
			carryFruit = this.carryLemon;
			break;
		case "ANY":case "NONE":
			carryFruit = this.carryFruitSum;
			break;
		case "PLUM":
			carryFruit = this.carryPlum;
			break;
		}
		if(carryFruit == 0) {
			if(this.inventory.getFruitAmount(fruit) == 0) {
				console.error(("troll " + this.id + " no " + fruit + " fruit in inventory"));
				return this.goHarvesting(fruit);
			} else {
				return this.getFruit(fruit);
			}
		} else {
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " is carrying " + fruit));
			let plantPos = this.board.getPlantPosition(this.pos);
			if(this.pos == plantPos) {
				let fruitToPlant = fruit == "ANY" ? this.getAnyFruit() : fruit;
				console.error(("troll " + this.id + " plant " + fruitToPlant));
				if(fruitToPlant == "NONE") {
					console.error(("Error: troll " + this.id + " has no fruit to plant"));
					return "";
				}
				console.error(("troll " + this.id + " completed task " + this.outputTask(this.isDoing)));
				this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Nothing;
				this.plantCounter++;
				return "PLANT " + this.id + " " + fruitToPlant;
			}
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " plant " + Std.string(plantPos) + " distance " + this.board.getDistance(this.pos,plantPos)));
			return this.evaluatePath(this.board.getPath(this.pos,plantPos),"Plant");
		}
	}
	getFruit(fruit) {
		console.error(("troll " + this.id + " has fruit in inventory"));
		let shackDistance = this.board.getDistance(this.pos,this.board.myShack);
		let closestTree = this.findClosestTree(fruit,-1,1);
		if(closestTree == ai_data_Tree.NO_TREE) {
			return this.getFruitFromShack(fruit);
		}
		if(shackDistance < this.board.getDistance(this.pos,closestTree.pos)) {
			return this.getFruitFromShack(fruit);
		} else {
			return this.goHarvesting(fruit);
		}
	}
	getFruitFromShack(fruit) {
		if(this.board.getDistance(this.pos,this.board.myShack) <= 1) {
			let fruitToPick = fruit == "ANY" ? this.inventory.getAnyFruit() : fruit;
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " pick fruit from shack"));
			if(fruitToPick == "NONE") {
				return "";
			} else {
				return "PICK " + this.id + " " + fruitToPick;
			}
		} else {
			let pathToShack = this.board.getPath(this.pos,this.board.myShack);
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " go to my shack"));
			return this.evaluatePath(pathToShack,"Shack");
		}
	}
	returnToShack() {
		let pathToShack = this.board.getPath(this.pos,this.board.myShack);
		if(pathToShack.length == 2) {
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " completed task " + this.outputTask(this.isDoing)));
			this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Nothing;
			return "DROP " + this.id;
		} else {
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " return to my shack"));
			return this.evaluatePath(pathToShack,"Shack");
		}
	}
	evaluatePath(path,target) {
		if(path.length == 0) {
			console.error(("Error: no path from troll " + this.id + ": " + Std.string(this.pos) + " to " + target));
			return "";
		} else if(path.length == 1) {
			console.error(("Error: troll is already at " + target));
			return "";
		} else {
			let a = this.movementSpeed;
			let b = path.length - 1;
			let nextPathPos = path[a < b ? a : b];
			ya_Set.add(this.board.occupiedPositions,nextPathPos);
			console.error(("troll " + this.id + " nextPos " + Std.string(nextPathPos)));
			return "MOVE " + this.id + " " + nextPathPos.x + " " + nextPathPos.y;
		}
	}
	findNextPos(trollPos,desiredPos,target) {
		if(!ya_Set.contains(this.board.occupiedPositions,desiredPos)) {
			return desiredPos;
		}
		let neighbors = this.board.getReacheableNeighbors(trollPos,this.movementSpeed);
		if(neighbors.length == 0) {
			return trollPos;
		}
		neighbors.sort(function(a,b) {
			let d1 = a.manhattanDistance(target);
			let d2 = b.manhattanDistance(target);
			if(d1 < d2) {
				return -1;
			} else if(d1 > d2) {
				return 1;
			} else {
				return 0;
			}
		});
		return neighbors[0];
	}
	findClosestTree(fruit,nearPlayer,minFruits,minSize) {
		if(minSize == null) {
			minSize = 1;
		}
		if(minFruits == null) {
			minFruits = 1;
		}
		let closestTree = ai_data_Tree.NO_TREE;
		let closestDistance = this.board.boardWidth * this.board.boardHeight;
		let _g = 0;
		let _g1 = this.board.trees;
		while(_g < _g1.length) {
			let tree = _g1[_g];
			++_g;
			if(fruit != "ANY" && tree.type != fruit) {
				continue;
			}
			if(this.board.targetTrees.h.__keys__[tree.pos.__id__] != null) {
				continue;
			}
			if(ya_Set.contains(this.board.occupiedPositions,tree.pos)) {
				continue;
			}
			switch(nearPlayer) {
			case 0:
				if(tree.isNearPlayer != 0) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if(tree.isNearPlayer != 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			default:
			}
			let distance = this.board.getDistance(this.pos,tree.pos);
			if(distance == -1) {
				console.error(("Error: no path from troll " + this.id + ": " + Std.string(this.pos) + " to tree " + Std.string(tree.pos)));
				continue;
			}
			let framesToTree = Math.ceil(distance / this.movementSpeed);
			let futureSize = tree.getSizeAfter(framesToTree);
			let futureFruits = tree.getFruitsAfter(framesToTree);
			if(futureSize < minSize) {
				continue;
			}
			if(futureFruits < minFruits) {
				continue;
			}
			if(distance < closestDistance) {
				closestTree = tree;
				closestDistance = distance;
			}
		}
		return closestTree;
	}
	findClosestIronNeighbor() {
		let closestIronNeighborPos = xa3_math_Pos.NO_POS;
		let closestDistance = this.board.boardWidth * this.board.boardHeight;
		let _g = 0;
		let _g1 = this.board.ironNeighbors;
		while(_g < _g1.length) {
			let ironNeighborPos = _g1[_g];
			++_g;
			let distance = this.board.getDistance(this.pos,ironNeighborPos);
			if(distance == -1) {
				console.error(("Error: no path from troll " + this.id + ": " + Std.string(this.pos) + " to ironNeighbor " + Std.string(ironNeighborPos)));
			} else if(distance < closestDistance) {
				closestIronNeighborPos = ironNeighborPos;
				closestDistance = distance;
			}
		}
		return closestIronNeighborPos;
	}
	getAnyFruit() {
		if(this.carryPlum > 0) {
			return "PLUM";
		}
		if(this.carryLemon > 0) {
			return "LEMON";
		}
		if(this.carryApple > 0) {
			return "APPLE";
		}
		if(this.carryBanana > 0) {
			return "BANANA";
		}
		return "NONE";
	}
	finishTask() {
		console.error(("troll " + this.id + " completed task " + this.outputTask(this.isDoing)));
		this.isDoing = ai_data_Task.Nothing;
	}
	outputTask(task) {
		if(task._hx_index == 2) {
			return "CoChop " + this.id + " " + Std.string(task.tree.pos);
		} else {
			return "" + Std.string(task);
		}
	}
}

	__class__: ai_data_Troll

class ai_factory_BoardFactory {
	static createBoard(boardWidth,boardHeight,lines,trees,treePositionsMap) {
		let positions = xa3_math_Pos.createPositions(boardWidth,boardHeight);
		let myShack = xa3_math_Pos.NO_POS;
		let oppShack = xa3_math_Pos.NO_POS;
		let seed = 0;
		let grid = [];
		let _g = 0;
		while(_g < boardHeight) {
			let y = _g++;
			grid.push([]);
			let line = lines[y].split("");
			let _g1 = 0;
			while(_g1 < boardWidth) {
				let x = _g1++;
				let cell = line[x];
				let pos = positions[y][x];
				if(cell == "0") {
					myShack = pos;
				} else if(cell == "1") {
					oppShack = pos;
				}
				grid[y].push(ai_factory_BoardFactory.getCellType(cell));
				seed += HxOverrides.cca(cell,0);
			}
		}
		let board = new ai_data_Board(boardWidth,boardHeight,positions,grid,new ai_factory_PathsFactory(boardWidth,boardHeight,grid,positions,myShack).createShackPaths(),myShack,oppShack,trees,treePositionsMap);
		board.addWaterAndIronNeighbors();
		board.addPlantPositions();
		board.addShacksDistance();
		ai_MainAi.seed = seed;
		return board;
	}
	static getCellType(s) {
		switch(s) {
		case "#":
			return 2;
		case "+":
			return 3;
		case "0":
			return 4;
		case "1":
			return 5;
		case "~":
			return 1;
		default:
			return 0;
		}
	}
}
ai_factory_BoardFactory.__name__ = true;
class ai_factory_PathsFactory {
	constructor(boardWidth,boardHeight,grid,positions,myShack) {
		this.boardWidth = boardWidth;
		this.boardHeight = boardHeight;
		this.grid = grid;
		this.positions = positions;
		this.myShack = myShack;
	}
	createShackPaths() {
		let _g = [];
		let _g1 = 0;
		let _g2 = this.boardWidth * this.boardHeight;
		while(_g1 < _g2) {
			++_g1;
			let _g2 = [];
			let _g3 = 0;
			let _g4 = this.boardWidth * this.boardHeight;
			while(_g3 < _g4) {
				++_g3;
				_g2.push([]);
			}
			_g.push(_g2);
		}
		let map2d = new astar_map2d_Map2D(this.boardWidth,this.boardHeight,0);
		let _g3 = new haxe_ds_IntMap();
		let _g4 = new haxe_ds_IntMap();
		_g4.h[1] = 1.0;
		_g4.h[8] = 1.0;
		_g4.h[4] = 1.0;
		_g4.h[2] = 1.0;
		_g4.h[16] = astar_map2d_Map2D.sqrt2;
		_g4.h[64] = astar_map2d_Map2D.sqrt2;
		_g4.h[32] = astar_map2d_Map2D.sqrt2;
		_g4.h[128] = astar_map2d_Map2D.sqrt2;
		_g3.h[0] = _g4;
		let _g5 = [];
		let _g6 = 0;
		let _g7 = this.boardHeight;
		while(_g6 < _g7) {
			let y = _g6++;
			let _g = 0;
			let _g1 = this.boardWidth;
			while(_g < _g1) _g5.push(this.grid[y][_g++]);
		}
		map2d.setMap(_g5);
		map2d.setCosts(_g3);
		map2d.astar.configureCache(true,1024);
		let startIndex = this.pos2Index(this.myShack);
		let _g8 = 0;
		let _g9 = this.boardWidth * this.boardHeight;
		while(_g8 < _g9) {
			let endIndex = _g8++;
			let startPos = this.index2Pos(startIndex);
			let endPos = this.index2Pos(endIndex);
			if(startIndex == endIndex) {
				_g[startIndex][endIndex] = [startPos];
				continue;
			}
			let startCell = this.grid[startPos.y][startPos.x];
			if(startCell == 1 || startCell == 2) {
				continue;
			}
			let endCell = this.grid[endPos.y][endPos.x];
			if(endCell == 1 || endCell == 2) {
				continue;
			}
			let solution = map2d.solve(startPos.x,startPos.y,endPos.x,endPos.y);
			if(solution.result == 1) {
				let _this = solution.path;
				let result = new Array(_this.length);
				let _g1 = 0;
				let _g2 = _this.length;
				while(_g1 < _g2) {
					let i = _g1++;
					let point2D = _this[i];
					result[i] = this.positions[point2D.y][point2D.x];
				}
				let backwardPath = result.slice();
				backwardPath.reverse();
				_g[startIndex][endIndex] = result;
				_g[endIndex][startIndex] = backwardPath;
				let mStartIndex = this.pos2Index(this.mirrorPos(this.index2Pos(startIndex)));
				let mEndIndex = this.pos2Index(this.mirrorPos(this.index2Pos(endIndex)));
				let result1 = new Array(result.length);
				let _g3 = 0;
				let _g4 = result.length;
				while(_g3 < _g4) {
					let i = _g3++;
					result1[i] = this.mirrorPos(result[i]);
				}
				let result2 = new Array(backwardPath.length);
				let _g5 = 0;
				let _g6 = backwardPath.length;
				while(_g5 < _g6) {
					let i = _g5++;
					result2[i] = this.mirrorPos(backwardPath[i]);
				}
				_g[mStartIndex][mEndIndex] = result1;
				_g[mEndIndex][mStartIndex] = result2;
			}
		}
		return _g;
	}
	index2Pos(index) {
		return this.positions[index / this.boardWidth | 0][index % this.boardWidth];
	}
	pos2Index(pos) {
		return pos.y * this.boardWidth + pos.x;
	}
	mirrorPos(pos) {
		return this.positions[this.boardHeight - pos.y - 1][this.boardWidth - pos.x - 1];
	}
}

class astar_SearchResult {
	constructor() {
		this.transitions = null;
		this.path = null;
		this.cost = 0;
		this.result = 0;
	}
	setResultPath(node) {
		this.result = 1;
		this.cost += node.costFromStart;
		if(this.path == null) {
			this.path = [];
			this.transitions = [];
		} else {
			node = node.previous;
		}
		while(node != null) {
			this.path.splice(0,0,node.state);
			this.transitions.splice(0,0,node.transition);
			node = node.previous;
		}
	}
	appendCachedNodes(node) {
		if(this.path == null) {
			this.path = [];
			this.transitions = [];
		}
		this.cost += node.costToEnd;
		while(node != null) {
			this.path.push(node.state);
			this.transitions.push(node.transition);
			node = node.next;
		}
	}
}

class astar_cache_BubbleList {
	constructor(capacity) {
		this.capacity = capacity;
		this.length = 0;
		this.head = null;
		this.middle = null;
		this.tail = null;
	}
	insert(elem) {
		if(this.head == null) {
			this.head = elem;
			this.middle = elem;
			this.tail = elem;
			elem.next = elem.previous = null;
		} else {
			if(this.length % 2 == 1) {
				let a = this.middle.previous;
				let b = this.middle;
				elem.previous = a;
				if(a != null) {
					a.next = elem;
				}
				elem.next = b;
				if(b != null) {
					b.previous = elem;
				}
				if(elem.previous == null) {
					this.head = elem;
				}
				if(elem.next == null) {
					this.tail = elem;
				}
			} else {
				let a = this.middle;
				let b = this.middle.next;
				elem.previous = a;
				if(a != null) {
					a.next = elem;
				}
				elem.next = b;
				if(b != null) {
					b.previous = elem;
				}
				if(elem.previous == null) {
					this.head = elem;
				}
				if(elem.next == null) {
					this.tail = elem;
				}
			}
			this.middle = elem;
		}
		this.length++;
		if(this.length > this.capacity) {
			let tmp;
			if(this.tail == null) {
				tmp = null;
			} else {
				let elem = this.tail;
				if(this.head == null) {
					throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Removing from empty list.");
				} else if(this.tail == this.head) {
					this.length = 0;
					this.head = null;
					this.middle = null;
					this.tail = null;
				} else {
					this.length--;
					if(elem.previous != null) {
						elem.previous.next = elem.next;
					}
					if(elem.next != null) {
						elem.next.previous = elem.previous;
					}
					if(elem == this.tail) {
						if(this.length % 2 == 0) {
							this.middle = this.middle.previous;
						}
					} else if(elem == this.middle) {
						this.middle = this.middle.next;
					} else if(this.length % 2 == 0) {
						this.middle = this.middle.previous;
					} else {
						this.middle = this.middle.next;
					}
					if(elem == this.tail) {
						this.tail = elem.previous;
					}
					if(elem == this.head) {
						this.head = elem.next;
					}
				}
				elem.next = elem.previous = null;
				tmp = elem;
			}
			return tmp;
		} else {
			return null;
		}
	}
	bubble(elem) {
		if(elem == this.head) {
			return;
		}
		elem.previous.next = elem.next;
		if(elem.next == null) {
			this.tail = elem.previous;
		} else {
			elem.next.previous = elem.previous;
		}
		let a = elem.previous.previous;
		let b = elem.previous;
		elem.previous = a;
		if(a != null) {
			a.next = elem;
		}
		elem.next = b;
		if(b != null) {
			b.previous = elem;
		}
		if(elem.previous == null) {
			this.head = elem;
		}
		if(elem.next == null) {
			this.tail = elem;
		}
		if(elem.next == this.middle) {
			this.middle = elem;
		} else if(elem == this.middle) {
			this.middle = elem.next;
		}
	}
	pop() {
		if(this.tail == null) {
			return null;
		} else {
			let elem = this.tail;
			if(this.head == null) {
				throw haxe_Exception.thrown("Removing from empty list.");
			} else if(this.tail == this.head) {
				this.length = 0;
				this.head = null;
				this.middle = null;
				this.tail = null;
			} else {
				this.length--;
				if(elem.previous != null) {
					elem.previous.next = elem.next;
				}
				if(elem.next != null) {
					elem.next.previous = elem.previous;
				}
				if(elem == this.tail) {
